name: Freeciv
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Freeciv, the free turn-based empire-building strategy game. Installs the Freeciv server from Debian's own packages, saves every turn to saves/, and runs server.serv at every start.
startup: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/container/lib FREECIV_DATA_PATH=/home/container/data:/home/container/.freeciv; exec ./bin/freeciv-server --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --saves saves --read server.serv --ruleset {{RULESET}} $([ "{{PUBLIC}}" = 1 ] && echo --meta)

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Freeciv. Installs the Freeciv server from Debian 13's own packages (the
# runtime image is Debian 13, so it runs as Debian built it), downloaded and
# signature-checked by apt. Your saves (saves/), settings (server.serv) and
# anything else you add are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/lists/partial" "$build/cache/archives/partial" "$build/root"

case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=amd64; triplet=x86_64-linux-gnu ;;
aarch64) arch=arm64; triplet=aarch64-linux-gnu ;;
*) fail "This Freeciv server runs on x86-64 and ARM64 machines only." ;;
esac

cat > "$build/sources.list" <<SRC
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian trixie main
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian trixie-updates main
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian-security trixie-security main
SRC
apt=(apt-get -q -o Dir::Etc::SourceList="$build/sources.list" -o Dir::Etc::SourceParts=/dev/null
    -o Dir::State::Lists="$build/lists" -o Dir::Cache="$build/cache" -o APT::Architecture="$arch"
    -o APT::Architectures="$arch" -o Debug::NoLocking=1)
echo "Reading Debian 13's package lists"
"${apt[@]}" update >"$build/apt.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 5 "$build/apt.log"; fail "Debian's package servers can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."; }
version=$("${apt[@]}" -o APT::Get::Show-Versions=1 --print-uris download freeciv-server 2>/dev/null |
    sed -n "s/.*freeciv-server_\([^_]*\)_.*/\1/p" | sed -n 1p | sed 's/%2b/+/gI; s/%3a/:/gI')
[ -n "$version" ] || fail "Debian's package lists have no Freeciv server for $arch."

if [ -x bin/freeciv-server ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Freeciv $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Freeciv $version"
    (cd "$build/cache/archives" && "${apt[@]}" download freeciv-server freeciv-data liblua5.4-0 libreadline8t64 readline-common >"$build/apt.log" 2>&1) ||
        { tail -n 5 "$build/apt.log"; fail "The download from Debian failed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    for d in "$build"/cache/archives/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$d" "$build/root"; done
    r="$build/root"
    rm -rf "$build/new" && mkdir -p "$build/new/bin" "$build/new/lib"
    mv "$r/usr/games/freeciv-server" "$build/new/bin/"
    mv "$r/usr/share/games/freeciv" "$build/new/data"
    cp -a "$r/usr/lib/$triplet"/liblua5.4.so.0* "$r/usr/lib/$triplet"/libreadline.so.8* "$build/new/lib/"
    rm -rf bin lib data
    mv "$build/new/bin" bin; mv "$build/new/lib" lib; mv "$build/new/data" data
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi

mkdir -p saves
# A starting settings file, only when there is none: the Panel sets the port
# and player limit at each start; the rest is yours to change.
[ -f server.serv ] || cat > server.serv <<'SERV'
# Freeciv server commands, run at every start (see "help" in the console).
set autosaves "TURN|GAMEOVER|QUITIDLE|INTERRUPT"
set saveturns 1
SERV
# The player limit, as a line Raptor rewrites at each start.
grep -q '^set maxplayers ' server.serv || echo "set maxplayers 16" >> server.serv
echo "Installed Freeciv $version from Debian 13."

variables.name: Ruleset
variables.description: The rules the game is played with: civ2civ3, classic, civ1, civ2, multiplayer, sandbox or alien, or a modpack's.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players, people and AIs together, the game can have.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: 1 lists the server on Freeciv's metaserver so players find it; 0 keeps it unlisted.
